responsibility: Implements the main analyzer execution engine and its coupling to region-model callbacks. This file defines impl_region_model_context for turning model actions into saved diagnostics, state-machine updates, bifurcations, and escaped-function notifications; constructs the supergraph, analysis_plan, checker set, known-function registry, and exploded_graph; drives worklist processing and post-analysis dumps; and manages the shared analyzer log file lifecycle for run_checkers.
same_name_distinction: Contains the analyzer’s full execution machinery behind run_checkers, including region-model context callbacks, checker/known-function registration, graph construction and processing, dumping, and logfile lifecycle management; engine.h only exposes the entrypoint.
